company.name: iWire Global
company.shortDescription: iWire Global is an IoT digital connectivity solutions company that offers smart facility management, supply chain, and logistics services.
company.description: iWire Global is a Dubai-based IoT and LPWAN connectivity company that develops communication infrastructure and monitoring solutions for smart utilities, industrial operations, logistics, facility management, and smart city applications. Founded in 2018, the company provides services across technologies such as Sigfox and LoRa, supporting device connectivity, asset tracking, environmental monitoring, and data management for large-scale IoT deployments in the Middle East, Africa, and other regions.
